rows.question: Mauzo yangu ni milioni 20 kwa mwaka, nitajua vipi ikiwa nalipa kodi ya mapato kwa makadirio au mfumo wa kawaida?

rows.question: NSSF ina mgawanyo mmoja tu wa 10 kwa 10 kati ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi, sivyo?
facts: NSSF split triggers: NSSF total is always 20% of gross wage. Three valid employer-employee split arrangements: (a) 10% employer + 10% employee — standard default; (b) 15% employer + 5% employee — employer elects to contribute more; (c) 20% employer + 0% employee — employer pays the full 20%, employee pays nothing. Employee share must never exceed 10%. All three arrangements are legal under the NSSF Act.

reply.completion: Hapana, si lazima kuwa 10/10 pekee. Sheria inaruhusu mgawanyo wowote unaofikia 20% ya jumla, ikiwa ni pamoja na 15/5, 20/0, 12/8, n.k. Mgawanyo wa 10/10 ndiyo mgawanyo rasmi uliotolewa na NSSF, lakini sheria haizuizi kuchagua mgawanyo mwingine. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.or.tz).<|end_of_text|>

rows.question: NSSF ina migawanyo gani halali kati ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi?

Employee share must never exceed 10%. All three arrangements are legal under the NSSF Act.

reply.completion: NSSF inakubali mgawanyo wa 10%+10% (mwajiri anachangia 10% na mfanyakazi anachangia 10%), 15%+5%, au 20%+0% (mwajiri analipa 20%). Mgawanyo wa 5%+15% si sahihi chini ya sheria ya NSSF. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.<|end_of_text|>
